summary: CRH public limited company filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) regarding its acquisition of Arcosa, Inc. via a merger. CRH's indirect wholly owned subsidiary, CRH Americas, Inc., will merge Merger Sub into Arcosa, with Arcosa surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary. Terms: $2.5 billion three-year term loan facility entered on July 17, 2026, supplementing a previously disclosed $5.75 billion bridge facility. No price per share or premium was stated. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The bridge and term loans will fund merger consideration, refinance Arcosa's debt, and pay fees. Watch for regulatory clearance and shareholder vote timelines; risk-arb spreads hinge on financing completion and antitrust approvals.
